description: Fetch statistical data from a Eurostat dataset by dataset code. Optionally filter by country (geo) and time period. Example: get_dataset({ dataset_code: "nama_10_gdp", geo: "DE", time: "2023" }). Common dataset codes: "nama_10_gdp" (GDP), "prc_hicp_minr" (HICP inflation, monthly indices and rates of change; filter unit "RCH_A" for the annual rate, coicop18 "TOTAL" for all items), "une_rt_m" (unemployment). Returns decoded rows in "observations" (newest first) with the dataset last-update date; a dataset Eurostat has stopped updating is reported as stale, never as an empty success. Codes are lowercase, underscore-separated and must come from search_datasets or list_datasets, a guessed or descriptive code is not a Eurostat code.

dataset_code.description: Eurostat dataset code from search_datasets or list_datasets, e.g. "nama_10_gdp", "prc_hicp_minr", "une_rt_m". Lowercase with underscores, not a title or a category word.

filters.description: Extra dimension filters as {dimension: code}, e.g. {"unit":"RCH_A","coicop18":"TOTAL"}. Dimension names are listed in the response "dimensions".

since.description: Earliest period to return, e.g. "2026-07". Use instead of time to get a recent window.

name: eurostat_get_dataset

dimensions.description: Dataset dimensions with labels and category mappings

updated.description: Last update timestamp of the dataset

value_count.description: Number of data values in the dataset

additionalProperties.description: Numeric value or null if missing

values.description: Data values indexed by dimension combination

title: Eurostat Get Dataset
